# Fixed sentences (generated by analysis/tcaclr_confirm/score_confirm.R, arm A, VALIDATION on consumed data, git efef5d6)

## H1 (tcaCLR minus aCLR, main truth)
VALIDATION RUN on consumed data, not a claim: tcaCLR exceeds aCLR in pooled co-membership AUPR on the consumed truth; the gain is carried by complexes of 20 or more genes; the E. coli preregistered test of the same readout did not meet the one-sided 0.025 threshold (M3D p = 0.079, EcoMAC p = 0.051).

- The total interval excludes no difference: a3r exceeded attention on yeast complexes (preregistered exploratory estimation; not a confirmatory test).
- The whole interval lies above the smallest effect of interest (+0.005).
- The whole interval lies above the E. coli estimate (+0.027).
- Exploratory estimation, not a confirmatory test, a replication or a validation. a3r is not adopted; this study cannot change that by itself (PI decisions 12 and 13 Nov).

## Breadth (sign test over complexes with 10 or more positives)
- The pooled gain is carried by 4 complexes; tcaCLR did not improve the median complex.

## H2 (size classes)
- H2: the prediction held (large positive, mid near zero, small not positive).

## H3 (comparators)
- tcaCLR cannot be declared the best of the 7 methods run: the experiment component is missing for |r|, so those comparisons have no p-value.
- Note: error bars for GENIE3, GRNBoost2 and PIDC comparisons include gene resampling only and are narrower than they should be.
- tcaCLR exceeds aCLR (Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.0001, 6 comparisons).
- tcaCLR exceeds CLR (Holm-adjusted one-sided p = 0.0041, 6 comparisons).
- tcaCLR versus |r|: no statement (experiment component missing).
- tcaCLR exceeds GENIE3 (Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.0001, 6 comparisons).
- tcaCLR exceeds PIDC (Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.0001, 6 comparisons).
- tcaCLR exceeds GRNBoost2 (Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.0001, 6 comparisons).
- Note: error bars for GENIE3, GRNBoost2 and PIDC comparisons include gene resampling only and are narrower than they should be.
- Trap: tcaCLR minus CLR has a smaller standard error than tcaCLR minus aCLR (on E. coli, k 0.016 to 0.027 against 0.037 to 0.041) and may exclude 0 where tcaCLR minus aCLR does not; this is never a basis for 'tcaCLR beats CLR' (E. coli S3).
